name: Thinking
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of the mind and heart in shaping a believer's life, urging careful guarding of the heart as the source of life’s outcomes (Proverbs 4:23). God’s thoughts toward His people are characterized by peace and hope, encouraging believers to focus their minds on what is true, pure, and praiseworthy (Jeremiah 29:11; Philippians 4:8). Transformation and discernment of God’s will come through the renewal of the mind, setting one’s affections on heavenly things rather than earthly concerns (Romans 12:2; Colossians 3:2). This biblical teaching distinguishes between negative thinking, which can harm the spirit, and positive thinking, which promotes joy and spiritual health (Proverbs 17:22).
